lxc_2ce2b0dcebb55f01.text: The assistant scanned the order number immediately.

lxc_089b7648615874c4.text: Without that number, the return would have taken much longer.

lxc_cd02206cc872d0cf.text: Always check the shop's own return policy for the exact documents they need.

lxc_292fe9a3ead867bf.text: Keep your explanation short and specific.

lxc_0c1ec96bfa1ae921.text: Say what is wrong, not just that you are unhappy.

lxc_6c7e527e881f1c43.text: Use these patterns: "The item is damaged."

lxc_c13779c4f21e67e5.text: , "The colour is different from the website."

lxc_13092f99c4217865.text: , or "It stopped working after one use."

lxc_3765c91da0693b03.text: For example, Carlos opened his headphones and found the left side had no sound.

lxc_90755f1b3dce55e7.text: He said to the assistant, "I bought these online and the left side doesn't work.

lxc_1152130fc92dd97e.text: That one clear sentence gave the assistant everything needed to start the return.

lxc_c9b4d2f1d41bb93d.text: Avoid long stories; one or two sentences are enough.

lxc_b5e24bf91beaf8f3.text: Once you have explained the problem, ask what options are available.

lxc_947ce1f1b98d883c.text: Two simple questions cover most situations: "Is it possible to get a refund?" and "Can I exchange this for the correct size?"

lxc_51933cfe36f5171d.text: If you are not sure which you prefer, ask: "What are my options?"

lxc_ad59a3301bc5b1c0.text: Always ask how the money is returned.

lxc_b000248ea8d291f5.text: Say: "Will the refund go back to my original payment method?" or "How long does the refund usually take?"

lxc_95802a704dc83ebc.text: Shops handle this differently, so it is important to ask.

lxc_48797b7cc15ef46e.text: The assistant cannot always give you an instant answer, but asking puts the information in front of you.

lxc_532ac7c78b564c7a.text: Yuki is at the returns desk with the item, its packaging, and her order confirmation.

lxc_d55088bf00c018db.text: The assistant asks what happened and whether she wants a refund or an exchange.

lxc_507493b7fd13d3cf.text: Bring your order confirmation email or order number, the item, and the original packaging if you have it.

lxc_062fcbb756ce09aa.text: Explain the problem in one or two clear sentences.

lxc_345c2bfecaad409c.text: Ask "Is it possible to get a refund?" or "Can I exchange this?" and use "What are my options?" if you are unsure.

lxc_e22c861742e9dced.text: Always ask how your money is returned and how long it takes.

lxc_04b50afcb3a497da.text: Every shop has its own return policy, so check the details before you go.

lxc_260c5103cc0f1413.text: Which sentence would help you start your own return clearly?
